source: paper Berkeley PCFG plus visible-name NNP bias
state_rule: Visible V4 profile name; NNP lexical prior has 0.6 weight on that name and common floor.
caveat: Only a proper-name lexical distribution is changed. The sampled sentence may be ungrammatical, and these two target probabilities do not sum to one because the NNP vocabulary is larger. No source fact or relation is conditioned in this PCFG.
